body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
Stablecoin market cap holds near $308B as Circle presses EU regulators on MiCA, warning only 3 of the top 50 stablecoins currently meet its requirements.
Stablecoin News
Stablecoin market cap steady near $308B
Total stablecoin supply sits around $308.45B per DeFiLlama, with USDT (~59.6% dominance) and USDC (~$72.4B) both trading essentially on peg despite a slight 0.2% pullback over 24 hours.
Circle presses EU to fix MiCA rules
Circle's Patrick Hansen said only 3 of the world's top 50 stablecoins currently meet MiCA requirements, calling for stronger global coordination to keep the EU competitive.
Revolut users rush out of USDT before delisting
Revolut clients moved $855M in a week and $2B over the past month out of USDT ahead of the token's planned delisting from the platform on August 31.
GENIUS Act stablecoin rulemaking deadline lands
A key U.S. stablecoin rulemaking deadline under the GENIUS Act arrived this week, coinciding with the July 28-29 FOMC meeting, adding fresh regulatory clarity pressure on issuers.
Hacking & Security Incidents
AFX-powered bridge drained of $24.15M
Attackers compromised private keys from five validators on an Arbitrum bridge to hit quorum and move funds; the 200-second challenge window passed with no challenge filed.
Triple-A treasury drain revised up to $11.8M
Payments firm Triple-A confirmed unauthorized access to hot wallets across TRON, Ethereum, TON and Solana, with funds still being actively drained 31 hours after first outflows.
Solido Money hack strips 293.7M SUPRA tokens
A two-wave attack on Solido Money drained 293.7M SUPRA tokens; on-chain tracing points to a large portion moving toward a suspected Gate.io deposit address.
H1 2026 sets record: $1.1B stolen across 212 exploits
Blockaid's H1 2026 report tallies 212 verified exploits, with DPRK-linked groups tied to the KelpDAO (~$292M) and Drift Protocol (~$285M) incidents alone.
